title: Mad Money
description: Three women (Diane Keaton, Queen Latifah, Katie Holmes) conspire to steal a pile of cash that the Federal Reserve Bank has earmarked for destruction.

title: Molly's Game
description: Molly Bloom runs the world's most exclusive high-stakes poker game for a decade before being arrested by the FBI. Her only ally is defense lawyer Charlie Jaffey, who learns that there is much more to Molly than the tabloids lead people to believe.

title: The Con Is On
description: In an effort to avoid paying off a massive gambling debt to a notorious mobster in England, two badly behaved con artists flee to Los Angeles, where they hatch a convoluted plot to steal jewels.

title: Life of Crime
description: Double-crosses and plot twists abound when a corrupt real-estate developer (Tim Robbins) decides not to pay a ransom to his wife's (Jennifer Aniston) kidnappers (John Hawkes, Yasiin Bey).

title: Killers
description: A woman's perfect suburban life explodes in a hail of bullets when she learns that her husband is an international superspy.

title: The Spy Who Dumped Me
description: Unexpectedly thrust into an international conspiracy, two best friends find themselves dodging deadly assassins and a suspicious British agent while hatching a plan to save the world.

title: Weeds
description:
S03 E01 — Doing the Backstroke
Nancy goes in search of Silas and her hijacked pot; Celia has Silas arrested for stealing her '`Drug Free Zone`' signs; Nancy visits Silas in jail and discovers that the pot is still in his car.

title: Weeds
description:
S03 E02 — A Pool and His Money
Nancy must strike new deals with Heylia and U-Turn; Celia must leave; Andy faces consequences for his good deed.

title: Weeds
description:
S03 E03 — The Brick Dance
Nancy gathers Silas, Shane, Andy, and Lupita to brainstorm ways to come up with the money to pay off her debt; Celia meets with her divorce lawyer.

title: Weeds
description:
S03 E04 — S... Highway
Nancy explores alternate sources of income; the city council needs Doug's vote; Conrad and Heylia set up their new grow house; Silas performs his community service.

title: Weeds
description:
S03 E05 — Bill Sussman
Nancy's and U-Turn's lives entangle; Celia and Doug make deals with Sullivan Groff; Conrad takes matters into his own hands; Shane starts summer school.

title: Weeds
description:
S03 E06 — Grasshopper
Nancy throws a cocktail party for town leaders; Celia's relationship with Sullivan deepens; U-Turn pays Conrad and Heylia a threatening visit; Silas meets Tara Lindman.

title: Weeds
description:
S03 E07 — He Taught Me How to Drive By
Nancy makes a deal for her future after U-Turn's death; Doug turns everyone against Sullivan; Andy receives a recommendation for a unique catering job; Shane has trouble fitting in.

title: Weeds
description:
S03 E08 — The Two Mrs. Scottsons
Nancy comes face-to-face with Peter's other ex-wife; Celia takes a bold step with Sullivan; Andy involves himself in the films he has been catering; Silas brings Tara on an errand.

title: Weeds
description:
S03 E09 — Release the Hounds
Nancy forges an unlikely friendship with Valerie; Celia's romance goes off course; Doug declares war on Sullivan; Conrad teaches Silas to grow.

title: Weeds
description:
S03 E10 — Roy Till Called
Nancy expands her distribution network; Celia continues to care for Dean; Doug faces scrutiny from the new Majestic City Council.

title: Weeds
description:
S03 E11 — Cankles
Valerie's private investigator tracks Nancy's every move; Celia investigates Aquatecture; Silas discovers that Tara is dating other guys.

title: Nurse Jackie
description:
S01 E01 — Pilot
A veteran nurse bends the rules to create something good from a patient's death, while hiding an addiction to painkillers.

title: Nurse Jackie
description:
S01 E02 — Sweet 'n All
Jackie and her husband are concerned about their daughter; the hospital administrator drinks Jackie's spiked coffee.

title: Nurse Jackie
description:
S01 E03 — Chicken Soup
An elderly patient treats heart disease with chicken soup; Jackie discusses her daughter's anxiety with Dr. O'Hara; Eddie learns he is being replaced.

title: Nurse Jackie
description:
S01 E04 — School Nurse
Jackie and Kevin consider enrolling Grace in private school; Dr. O'Hara must endure a boy's emotional thanks; Zoey loses a patient.

title: Nurse Jackie
description:
S01 E05 — Daffodil
Jackie breaks rules to help a girl, caring for her mother; Mrs. Akalitus tasers herself; O'Hara treats Zoey to a meal.

title: Nurse Jackie
description:
S01 E06 — Tiny Bubbles
An old friend of Jackie's checks into the hospital with terminal lung cancer; Dr. Cooper's mother has a gall bladder attack and reveals a family secret.

title: Nurse Jackie
description:
S01 E07 — Steak Knife
A man is attacked by his date's ex-husband; Mrs. Akalitus takes charge of a foundling; O'Hara has a personal crisis.

title: Nurse Jackie
description:
S01 E08 — Pupil
Jackie discovers a new temp nurse is abusing drugs; Mrs. Akalitus continues to care for the foundling; Coop tells Eddie that Jackie has a child.

title: Nurse Jackie
description:
S01 E09 — Nose Bleed
Jackie admits a dying patient she previously treated; O'Hara tells a sister Jackie's secrets; an organ donation form is forged.

title: Nurse Jackie
description:
S01 E10 — Ring Finger
Jackie uses an unusual ploy to get Coop off her back; O'Hara helps Jackie remove her wedding ring; Jackie begins mother-daughter dance lessons with Grace.

title: Divergent
description: In a future society, people are divided into factions based on their personalities. After a young woman (Shailene Woodley) learns she is a Divergent and will never fit into any one group, she uncovers a conspiracy to destroy all those like her.

title: The Divergent Series: Insurgent
description: Fugitives Tris and Four search for allies and answers among the ruins of Chicago while arduously trying to evade Jeanine, leader of the Erudite.

title: The Divergent Series: Allegiant
description: As a ruthless battle threatens humanity, Tris and Four journey beyond the wall that encloses Chicago to find a peaceful solution for their embroiled city.

title: Twilight
description: A high-school student is caught up in a romance with a vampire, whose family has renounced the drinking of human blood.

title: The Twilight Saga: New Moon
description: After the abrupt departure of Edward, her vampire love, Bella finds comfort in her deepening friendship with Jacob Black. However, Bella's loyalties are put to the test as she becomes drawn into the world of werewolves, ancient enemies of vampires.

title: The Twilight Saga: Eclipse
description: Bella must choose between Edward and Jacob amid a string of mysterious killings and a malicious vampire's quest for revenge.

title: The Twilight Saga: Breaking Dawn Part 1
description: A chain of events, set off by Edward and Bella's marriage, honeymoon and birth of a child, yields a shocking development for Jacob.

title: The Twilight Saga: Breaking Dawn Part 2
description: Bella and Edward gather werewolves, vampires and other allies to help them protect their daughter from the Volturi.

title: The Wedding Pact
description: Upon learning that his best friend (Haylie Duff) from college is still single, a guy (Chris Soldevilla) travels across the country to find her and follow through on a pact they made 10 years earlier.

title: The Honeymoon
description: Adam whisks his new bride Sarah to Venice for a honeymoon, but Adam's gross best friend Bav tags along. A charming gangster Giorgio falls for Sarah, sending Adam and Bav across the border on a drug-dealing mission.

title: The Big Wedding
description: A long-divorced couple must pretend they're still happily married when their adopted son's ultraconservative biological mother flies in for the young man's nuptials.

title: Last Chance Harvey
description: Love blooms unexpectedly between an unemployed jingle writer (Dustin Hoffman) and a prickly British government worker (Emma Thompson).

title: The Royals
description:
S02 E10 — The Serpent That Did Sting Thy Father's Life
The royal family faces the possibility of the abolition of the monarchy.

title: The Royals
description:
S03 E01 — Together With Remembrance of Ourselves
The royal family returns with a fresh perspective; Liam seeks solace in disreputable places.

title: Grace and Frankie

Coyote confirms Allison's suspicion that Bud is lying to her; Grace goes after Nick for his tell-all book; Frankie seeks a happy ending of her own.

title: Grace and Frankie
description:

Grace craves a comforting dish from her childhood, but only her estranged brother has the recipe; Sol and Peter team up to blackmail a theater critic.

description:

Frankie throws herself a funeral, leaving Grace to attend an important meeting alone; to Brianna's annoyance, her family rallies around Barry.

title: Grace and Frankie
description:

Robert finally comes to terms with his memory loss; Grace and Frankie confront the possibility of immediate death, or aging for a few more years.

Grace and Frankie are stunned when their husbands inform them that they want divorces; they're even more stunned when they find out why.

Celia's antics get her kicked off the set of Isabelle's commercial; Andy hooks up with the Rabbinical School admissions officer; Nancy and Conrad fear a raid.

description:

Nancy contends with Shane's puppy love and Silas' failing grades; Andy recovers; Dean's mistake seals Celia's victory over Doug.

description:

Nancy and Conrad make their first sale to Snoop Dogg; Peter informs Nancy that a bust must be made; Heylia learns of Conrad's betrayal.
